mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, code, plan_type, qc_level, major_aql, general_aql, remark
mapper.select:
select qsp.id, qsp.create_time as createTime, qsp.update_time as updateTime, qsp.create_user_name as createUserName, qsp.update_user_name as updateUserName, qsp.code, qsp.plan_type as planType, qsp.qc_level as qcLevel, qsp.major_aql as majorAql, qsp.general_aql as generalAql, qsp.remark as remark, qspqtr.id as qcTypeId, qspqtr.qc_type as qcType, qspqtr.disabled as disabled from qc_sampling_plan qsp left join qc_sampling_plan_qc_type_ref qspqtr on qsp.id = qspqtr.main_id and qspqtr.is_deleted = FALSE where qsp.is_deleted = FALSE
AND qspqtr.qc_type IN
#{qcType}
order by id desc
